title: Market extract record (frontmatter)
description: One COMPETING PRODUCT, deep-read (spec L-2). Pricing, features, reception, adoption, corporate status and lifecycle are FIELDS on that record, not records of their own — the same product on three aggregators would otherwise yield three records synthesis must re-merge. The vendor's own site is read HERE, inside extract, not as a search angle (L-11). SHAPE ONLY: whether a tier is argued well is the reviewing twin's judgment.

outcome.description: `skipped` is the L-8 relevance bail, taken at the FRONT of the child. A skipped record still ships: an unread candidate recorded with its reason is evidence, a missing file is indistinguishable from an oversight (#20).

cause.description: `site-unreachable` is a retrieval failure, never a finding that the product does not exist. `forbidden-by-terms` is a decision, not a failure.

tier.description: L-4: evidence-first tiers, never a computed score. A multiplied model guess yields a precise-looking number with no traceable basis, uncheckable by validator or reviewer alike.

overlapping_capabilities.description: Required non-empty on a `direct` row — head-to-head is a claim about WHICH capabilities are shared, and a direct tier that names none is an assertion.

positioning.description: How the vendor positions itself, in its own terms. The vendor's claim is evidence of the claim, never evidence it is true.

source_authority.description: L-7. Ranking and dedupe input only, never a cut. On conflict first-party wins for commercial facts: aggregators lag pricing by months, a pricing page is definitionally current.

lifecycle.description: L-5: a dead competitor is first-class evidence — the highest-value input to a risk section, and no competitor-comparison source carries it. A dated discontinuation is a provable fact where 'nobody built this' is an unprovable absence.

pricing.description: Commercial facts decay fastest, so every one carries the date it was true.

reception.description: A rating without its denominator is not a signal — 4.8 from 6 reviews and 4.8 from 6,000 are different facts.

capability_tags.description: The scope capabilities this product overlaps. These are what downstream document authoring consumes from the register.
